error.memory: The script is using too much memory
hint.memory: Keep fewer lists, objects and texts alive at once, or stop adding to them forever.
hint.unsupported: This game teaches a smaller part of JavaScript. Try rewriting it with variables, if, while, for, functions, lists and objects.
hint.notDefined: Declare it with let or const before using it, and check how it is spelled.
hint.beforeInit: Move the line that declares it above the line that uses it.
hint.constAssign: A const never changes. Declare it with let if its value must change.
hint.invalidOperation: Check the types of the values: a list or an object cannot be added, compared or counted like a number.
hint.notAFunction: Only functions can be called with (). Check the name, and that it holds a function.
hint.notAFunctionExpression: Only functions can be called with (). Check what the expression gives back.
hint.unknownValue: Check how the constant is spelled, in capital letters.
hint.unknownCommand: Check how the command is spelled. Commands exist in English and in Portuguese, and uppercase and lowercase letters matter.
hint.callDepth: A function that calls itself needs a case where it stops calling itself.
hint.propertyNotAllowed: This name is reserved by the game. Pick another name for the property.
hint.listTooBig: Lists are limited in size. Remove items you no longer need, or stop growing the list forever.
error.objectTooBig: The object has too many properties
hint.objectTooBig: Objects are limited in size. Keep fewer properties, or reuse the same ones.
hint.textTooLong: Texts are limited in size. Do not keep doubling or adding to a text forever.
hint.valueTooBig: Pass a smaller value: a list or object that holds itself many times over is too big to send.
hint.cannotRead: The value before the dot does not exist yet. Check that it was set.
hint.cannotSet: Only lists and objects hold properties. Check that the variable holds one.
hint.invalidListPosition: Use a whole number from 0 up to the length of the list, filling the list in order.
error.tooDeep: The script went too deep: calls or values nested too far for the machine to follow
hint.tooDeep: Use fewer nested calls or nested values, and make sure recursion stops.
error.computeTooLong: The script spent more than {ticks} ticks calculating without giving a command (is there an infinite loop?)
hint.computeTooLong: Put a command that takes time, such as wait(1), inside the loop, or make the loop end.
error.idleRounds: The script ran for too long without spending any ticks (is there an infinite loop?)
hint.idleRounds: A loop that spends no time never ends. Make its condition change, or add a command that takes time.
hint.syntaxUnexpectedToken: Look at the character in this line, or at the line before it, for a missing or extra symbol such as ) or ;.
hint.syntaxUnterminatedString: Close the text with the same quote mark that opened it, on the same line.
hint.syntaxUnterminatedTemplate: Close the template string with a backtick (`).
hint.syntaxAlreadyDeclared: Use another name, or drop the let or const to change the value that already exists.
hint.syntaxUnexpectedChar: Remove the character, or write it inside a text between quotes.
error.syntaxReturnOutside: 'return' can only be used inside a function
hint.syntaxReturnOutside: Write the return inside a function, or remove it.
hint.syntaxInvalidAssignment: Only a variable, a list position or an object property can receive a value with =.
error.syntaxReservedWord: This word is reserved by JavaScript
hint.syntaxReservedWord: Pick another name: words such as if, for and while have a fixed meaning.
error.constantGroup: {name} is a group of constants, not a value
hint.constantGroup: Pick one of its constants, for example {example}.
hint.syntaxGeneric: Read the line again and check that it is written like the examples in the lessons.
hint.moveExpectsDirection: Use a direction constant, for example Dir.NORTH.
hint.plantExpectsSpecies: Use a plant constant, for example Plant.GRASS.
hint.getStockExpectsItem: Use an item constant, for example Item.HAY.
error.waitExpectsTicks: {name} expects a whole number of ticks
hint.waitExpectsTicks: Use a whole number that is zero or more, such as 10.
hint.layerLocked: Write it with what the earlier layers teach, or reach layer {layer} to use it.
feature.literal: numbers and text written in the code
feature.functionCall: calling a function of your own
